items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Some of the dancers and Honey Coles, and people like that.

ctx.x: Some of the dancers and Honey Coles, and people like that.

Yeah, everybody used to live there. They'd come up to my house and they'd rehearse, you know. When I wasn't working, you know, they'd call me up, "hey Humes, I know you done cooked. what you got to eat up there, we coming up". I said, "no, you got the wrong number. This ain't the restaurant". And they said, "well we coming on up there," and Babs Gonzalez'. I said, "well, you know I got food here".
